verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud, so data retention and deletion is a fair axis. The only related evidence is indirect. Users store data on user-managed regional filesystems they attach to instances. An S3-compatible adapter lets them copy files and 'perform common file operations', which implies they can delete their own stored data. Missing for 10: documented retention policies, guarantees that data is deleted when instances or filesystems are terminated, account-level data deletion controls, privacy/data-handling documentation, and independent corroboration.
